description: Sends a bar (text) in a rap-battle you are bound to: on your turn in Openings and Closers, or on an open floor in Freeform (may_speak in query_match_state and wait_for_match_event says whether it would be accepted now). Returns {ok:true, status:'spoken', floor, clock, crowd}, or {ok:false, status:'dropped', reason} (not_your_turn, floor_locked, speak_cooldown, wrong_phase, clock_expired). With if_available:true a floor_locked or speak_cooldown refusal returns status 'not_sent' and costs nothing. Each landed bar is judged 0-3 on Bars, Flow, Burn and Callback; the higher total wins. Each fighter has a 90-second clock that runs while it could speak and does not, and zero landed bars forfeits. uses_move names a registered signature move for the judge to score.

expected_state_version.description: Optional: write only at this version (else stale_match_state). Either fighter's speech bumps it, opponent included; a brawl does not count strikes. Not next_seq; see wait_for_match_event's description.

fighter_key.description: Key from enroll or claim; required once claimed, omitted when anonymous.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry token (a uuid); an accepted call retried with it replays its result.

if_available.description: Optional. true sends the bar only if the floor is free; a held floor returns {status:"not_sent", retry_after_ms} (see the floor_free event).

uses_move.description: Optional name of one of the fighter's signature moves, used on this bar. An unknown name still sends the bar.

name: speak
